acceptedContract.acceptanceBoundary: Shared behavior only; it is not a public deployment, installed-client, SDK, or Wallet UI acceptance.

runtime.sourceIdentity: GET /version emits the exact operator-provided build sourceCommit, release, and schema versions. GET /health and GET /ready expose only truthful runtime/deployment booleans.

cors.migration: Registry v3 normalizes to webOrigins: [] and is denied browser CORS. A deployment must explicitly submit a reviewed v4 registry entry with an enabled product and exact canonical HTTPS origin.
cors.preflight: Only registered enabled origins may preflight listed Product Session POST routes. Allowed request headers are content-type and x-ynx-product-session-proof; unknown origins, routes, methods, and headers fail closed before body processing.
cors.nonInference: No origin is derived from productId, bundleId, callback, or URL scheme.

runtime.productSession: Completion, introspection, expiry, session/approval/device revoke, replay protection and disk restart persistence remain kernel-bound; an origin rejection does not execute or mutate a Product Session route.
runtime.deviceProof: P-256 SHA-256 canonical request proofs bind product client, bundle, device public key, method, canonical path, body digest, nonce, issuedAt, and expiresAt. The runtime does not create local or canned sessions.

walletPlatform.providerBehavior: Use EIP-1193 standard connection independently of Product Session. A private Gateway failure degrades only the private feature, never the established standard provider.
walletPlatform.callbackRules: Persist one pending record before launch; accept exactly one registered callback response field; reject unknown, expired, replayed, substituted, or non-canonical callback data.
walletPlatform.deviceProof: Keep the platform key in secure storage and send canonical P-256 proof material only through the shared package. Do not duplicate cryptography or construct deep links by string concatenation.
walletPlatform.uiBoundary: This handoff supplies no Wallet UI implementation.

developerSdk.publicSchemas: Expose the standard EIP-1193 path first. Treat Product Session upgrade as an optional first-party private API operation.
developerSdk.errorMapping: Preserve EIP-1193 4001/4100/4200/4900/4901 separately from Product Session protocol, expiry, device-proof, callback, and gateway codes. Preserve correlation IDs.
developerSdk.migration: Use registered canonical origin, callback, request body, and proof APIs only; no direct Gateway calls and no duplicated cryptography.

financialApps.ordering: Establish Standard Connection before optionally upgrading to Product Session.
financialApps.boundary: Public/read-only data remains available when Product Session is degraded; private capabilities must surface typed errors and retry action.
financialApps.migration: Do not add per-product CORS, callback, or Gateway routes. Consume the SDK after its owner publishes an accepted implementation.

explorerMonitor.safeProbe: GET /health, /ready, and /version may be probed without a user key; report source identity and deployment booleans exactly as returned.
explorerMonitor.redaction: Never collect Product Session proofs, callback responses, device public/private key material, raw authorization bodies, or session records.
explorerMonitor.statusClasses: Distinguish no route, origin rejected, protocol rejected, expiry, replay, revoke, and gateway unreachable; do not present them as chain offline.

dataFabric.events: Consume only redacted asynchronous lifecycle events keyed by correlation ID and typed status. No synchronous dependency may block a standard wallet connection.
dataFabric.privacy: Do not ingest raw proof, callback, session, account secret, or device key material.
